## ISO Grid Android (replaces ISO Pro APK)

- **Package:** `com.isogrid.app` — uninstall old `com.isopro.app` before installing
- **Asset:** `iso-grid.apk`
- **Native build:** `3`
- **Push notifications:** FCM enabled
- **API:** https://iso-pro-b0grfvh9hcc5chgf.southafricanorth-01.azurewebsites.net

### Admin console after install

1. **Admin → Native app & OTA**
2. Set **Minimum native build** to `3`
3. Set **Latest APK URL** to `https://github.com/Mr-Ninja1/ISO/releases/latest/download/iso-grid.apk`

### Install

1. Download `iso-grid.apk`
2. Allow install from browser/files if prompted
3. Open app → sign in → allow notifications
